NatureWise Turmeric Curcumin uses organic turmeric extract that has been standardized to 95% curcuminoids, the good nutrients found in turmeric, to deliver the benefits of this root. paragraphs: Adults, should take 3 capsules per day, divided into separate doses and taken with food and water, or as recommended by your healthcare provider.
NatureWise Turmeric Curcumin should always be taken in conjunction with a healthy diet and regular exercise program.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: As with any dietary supplement, you should consult your healthcare provider before use, especially if you are pregnant, nursing, have a medical condition, are taking medications, or have known adverse reactions or allergies.
Keep out of the reach of children. Do not use if safety seal is damaged or missing. Store in a cool, dry place.
